Average order value = average of order_total across all orders placed by customers whose first_ordered_at is in 2024.

```sql
SELECT AVG(o.order_total) AS average_order_value
FROM jaffle_shop.dev.orders o
JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', c.first_ordered_at) = '2024'
```
